title: FAQ banner block missing entirely on /faqs/limited-by-guarantee/ and /faqs/limited-by-shares/ — NEEDS A LINEAR TICKET
body: **Migrated by Planning 2026-09-04 from the retired pre-cutover task set (was proposal P2, surfaced by legacy task T9 / CORE-7013 verification on 2026-08-24). It has NO Linear ticket and was on no board — it would have been lost when the legacy set was retired.** Surfaced while verifying CORE-7013, and a **different defect from that ticket**. CORE-7013 is about banner *resolution*. While sweeping all 23 FAQ topic pages to verify it, two pages turned out to have **no banner at all** on the clone, while live renders one. | Page | Live | Clone | |---|---|---| | `/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/` | banner, 800px master shown at 1170×252 | **no banner element** | | `/faqs/limited-by-shares/` | banner, 800px master shown at 1170×252 | **no banner element** | Measured at viewport 1800 on both sites: on the clone neither page has any `` wider than 400px above y=700 (16 images present, widest is a 275×28 logo at y=1093). The other **21 FAQ topic pages all render the banner correctly**. Most likely the banner block was never added to these two pages in the CMS (a **seeding gap**) rather than a code defect — the shared template works on the other 21. **Confirm in Payload before treating it as code.** Not fixed under CORE-7013: that ticket is scoped to resolution, its acceptance criteria say the crop and block must otherwise stay as-is, and a missing block is a separate class of defect.
acceptanceCriteria: Raise a Linear ticket for this (it has none) and link it here — it is a real prod defect that no ticket currently covers.

Confirm in Payload first whether the banner block is simply absent from these two page documents (seeding gap) rather than a code defect — the other 21 FAQ topic pages render correctly from the shared template.
`/faqs/limited-by-guarantee/` and `/faqs/limited-by-shares/` render the FAQ banner, matching live in position, crop and size (1170×250 at desktop).
The banner image is served at ≥ its displayed size, consistent with the other 21 FAQ topic pages (1170×250 master).
No change to the other 21 FAQ topic pages, which already render correctly. Verified at 360 / 768 / 1024 / 1800 against live.
